==Purpose of template==
Convert Gregorian calendar dates to the [[Farede]] calendar equivalent.

==How to use==
<pre>{{GregoriantoFarede|Month day}}</pre>

==Examples==
<pre>{{GregoriantoFarede}}</pre>
{{GregoriantoFarede}}

<pre>{{GregoriantoFarede|January 1}}</pre>
{{GregoriantoFarede|January 1}}

<pre>{{GregoriantoFarede|February 28}}</pre>
{{GregoriantoFarede|February 28}}

<pre>{{GregoriantoFarede|February 29}}</pre>
{{GregoriantoFarede|February 29}}

<pre>{{GregoriantoFarede|February 30}}</pre>
{{GregoriantoFarede|February 30}}

<pre>{{GregoriantoFarede|{{#time:F j|{{Date}}}}}}</pre>
{{GregoriantoFarede|{{#time:F j|{{Date}}}}}}
